subject: POC: success criteria & next steps - Stellar Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@stellar-commerce.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC: success criteria & next steps - Stellar Commerce

Hi Alex — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff. Please review and confirm any edits.

Summary of agreed scope:
- Evaluate Redwood inference runtime on a 2-week POC for Stellar Commerce checkout recommendations (multi-turn prompt, 1k-3k token sequences).
- Focus areas: latency under 150ms p95, qualitative relevance of recommendations, and per-token cost estimate for expected QPS.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: p95 <= 150ms for 99% of requests in the 9am-6pm window using a 2-node Dedicated-like configuration.
2) Accuracy: top-3 recommendation relevance >= 85% on your holdout evaluation set.
3) Cost: token/unit cost estimate delivered with a plan to reach target cost / transaction.
4) Stability: no production-level errors or data leakage within test dataset.

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Data & sampling: Stellar to provide sample dataset & schema (Jordan to own).
- Runbook & infra: Dev Patel (SE) to provision test harness, connector, and detailed runbook.
- Success measurement: Neha to run qualitative checks and compile eval report with your stakeholders.

Timeline:
- Thu 10/22: Deliver sample data + schema (Stellar).
- Mon 10/26: Kickoff + baseline run (Redwood + Stellar).
- Week of 11/02: Iteration and tuning.
- Fri 11/13: Final evaluation report and next-step recommendation.

Immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) Alex/Jordan: confirm sample data delivery date (target 10/22).
2) Marissa/Dev: share POC plan and risk tracker (attached).
3) Schedule 30-min kickoff for 10/26 morning — propose 10/26 10:00am PT.

Attachments: POC-Plan-v1.xlsx (POC outline, test matrix, initial risk register).

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligned with what we discussed. A couple of notes and one risk to call out: 

1) Data delivery: We will deliver a ~50k-row sampled extract by 10/22. Jordan will share schema and column-level descriptions.
2) Masking: We'll need confirmation on what PII fields Redwood needs and your suggested masking approach — we prefer tokenization/masking on our side. Can you confirm?
3) Risk (blocking): Our current connector in our sandbox is at v1.2.0; we recently upgraded prod to v1.4.0 and there are breaking changes to the blob URI format. If Redwood's connector expects v1.4, we may need to run a compatibility shim. Jordan will attach the sample schema.

We also looped in procurement for timing on the one-off POC SOW.

Attachments: sample-data-schema.csv

Appreciate it — confirm the 10/26 10am PT kickoff and we'll lock the calendar.

— Alex
Head of Data Science, Stellar Commerce
alex.j@stellar-commerce.com

Hi Alex / team — thanks for the heads-up on the connector version mismatch. Quick responses and mitigation plan: 

- Connector compatibility: We have a compatibility shim that supports both v1.2.x and v1.4.x, but there is a known intermittent bug when the blob URI includes the new region tag. I'm attaching the patch we typically deploy in POCs (connector-patch.diff).
- Mitigation: For kickoff we can deploy the shim and a sha-checked connector build to your sandbox. Dev estimate: 2 engineer-days to validate. Owner: Dev Patel (Redwood).
- Data masking: We support both server-side and client-side masking. For POC I'd recommend Stellar performs column-level masking of PII and we also apply tokenization at ingestion as an additional layer. Owner: Jordan (Stellar) + Dev (Redwood).
- Blockers: If the shim fails to address the URI parsing error, escalation path is to open a high-priority bug with our infra team and, if needed, Redwood will stand up a temporary proxy to normalize URIs. Escalation contact: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek@redwood.com).

Next actions I will take this week:
1) Share test-run instructions and a sandbox connector image by 10/23.
2) Validate sample schema against connector expectations (I may ask for a small sample file).
3) Add the connector patch as a mitigation entry in the risk tracker.

I'll update the attached POC-Plan with these mitigations.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com
